# Reserved-without-index fixture

A roster with no INDEX.md beside it. ADR-006 is reserved and fileless, so the
`backed` set's reserved component is the only thing keeping it quiet — the
"listed in the roster with no file" branch's INDEX guard cannot help, since
there is no INDEX to list it in.
